mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of months with a month-over-month decline in FEDFUNDS.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent month-over-month increase in both housing starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals strong aggregate demand growth, which boosts corporate earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS increased month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply-constrained economic regime (as indicated by industrial production below 100), a month-over-month increase in industrial production signals improving supply conditions, which reduces input costs and boosts corporate margins, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO is below 100 and INDPRO increased month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month increase in the CPI (CPIAUCSL) above 0.5% signals accelerating inflation, which typically triggers a monetary policy tightening and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where CPIAUCSL increased by more than 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals robust residential construction activity, which is a leading indicator of economic expansion and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of months with a month-over-month increase in HOUST.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent month-over-month increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) and decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strengthening labor market, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where PAYEMS increased and UNRATE decreased month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-unemployment regime (UNRATE > 5.5%), a month-over-month decline in the unemployment rate signals improving labor market conditions, which boosts consumer confidence and corporate investment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE > 5.5% and UNRATE decreased month-over-month.
